requiredBeforeFiling.why: the shared semantics refuse an agency name on any form
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the agency or court that dismissed the charge, if it was dismissed

requiredBeforeFiling.why: an appellate number is a different number from the trial court's, and the platform holds only the trial court's
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the APPELLATE court's case number, if there was an appeal; write N/A if there was not

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the ATN is assigned by the agency when an arrest is processed and identifies it through a system the platform has no knowledge of
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the ATN, from your arrest paperwork or your DPS criminal history record; write N/A if you do not have one

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds the name of the offence and holds no statute-section fact for it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Alaska statute or ordinance number of the charge, from your paperwork or your DPS record; the name of the offence beside it is already filled

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no acquittal date for this matter
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date you were acquitted, if you were; write N/A if you were not

requiredBeforeFiling.why: this caption carries the word CHARGE and resolves to the name of the offence rather than to a date, so anchoring it would print an offence name into a date box; and the platform holds no dismissal date for this matter
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the charge was dismissed, if it was; write N/A if it was not

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: PART II - DATE CONVICTION REVERSED OR VACATED
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: PART II - DATE CONVICTION REVERSED OR VACATED
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no reversal date for this matter
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the conviction was reversed or vacated, if it was - PART IV section D requires the court order that did it

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no pardon fact for this matter
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date you were pardoned, if you were - PART IV section D requires the Governor's Pardon itself

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no sentencing date for this matter
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date you were sentenced, if you were; write N/A if you were not

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: PART II - ALASKA DRIVERS LICENSE # OR STATE ID #
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: PART II - ALASKA DRIVERS LICENSE # OR STATE ID #
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the shared semantics refuse a government identifier on any form
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your Alaska driver's licence or state ID number

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: PART II - FORMER OR OTHER NAMES/ALIASES
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: PART II - FORMER OR OTHER NAMES/ALIASES
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no alias fact, and writing the legal name here would assert an alias that may not exist
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: any prior name, nickname or alias your records might be held under; write N/A if there are none

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: PART II - NAME OF APPELLATE COURT
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: PART II - NAME OF APPELLATE COURT
requiredBeforeFiling.why: this caption resolves under the shared naming rules to the APPLICANT'S OWN NAME, so it is never anchored
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the appellate court, if there was an appeal; write N/A if there was not

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: PART II - NAME OF ARRESTING AGENCY
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: PART II - NAME OF ARRESTING AGENCY
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the shared semantics refuse an agency name on any form, so the platform cannot write one here whatever it holds
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the agency that arrested or cited you

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: PART II - NAME OF ARRESTING OFFICER
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: PART II - NAME OF ARRESTING OFFICER
requiredBeforeFiling.why: this caption resolves under the shared naming rules to the APPLICANT'S OWN NAME, so it is never anchored: writing here would print your name where the officer's belongs
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the officer who arrested or cited you - the same officer whose signature PART IV section A needs

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: PART II - NAME OF PROSECUTING AGENCY
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: PART II - NAME OF PROSECUTING AGENCY
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the shared semantics refuse an agency name on any form
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the office that prosecuted, or would have prosecuted, the case; write N/A if the charges were never referred

requiredBeforeFiling.why: a prosecutor's name is a court-and-prosecutor fact the platform does not hold
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the prosecutor - the same person whose signature PART IV section B needs if charges were referred

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: PART II - NAME OF TRIAL COURT
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: PART II - NAME OF TRIAL COURT
requiredBeforeFiling.why: this caption resolves under the shared naming rules to the APPLICANT'S OWN NAME, so it is never anchored: writing here would print your name where the court's belongs
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the court that handled the case

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: PART III - explanation of mistaken identity or false accusation
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: PART III - explanation of mistaken identity or false accusation
requiredBeforeFiling.why: this is a sworn narrative to a beyond-a-reasonable-doubt standard about the participant's own case, and nobody can write it for them
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own account of the circumstances, which must show beyond a reasonable doubt that the charge(s) resulted from mistaken identity or false accusation. If it was mistaken identity, give the name and description of the person you were mistaken for, if known; if it was a false accusation, give the name and description of the person who made it, if known. Use additional sheets if you need them

requiredBeforeFiling.why: this caption resolves to the same fact as the trial court's case number, so anchoring it would print the court's number where the police department's belongs
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the POLICE department's own case number, which is not the court's number. The platform holds the trial court number and writes that one, three rows below

requiredBeforeFiling.why: this caption resolves to the same fact as the trial court's case number, so anchoring it would print the court's number where the prosecutor's belongs
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the PROSECUTOR's own case number, which is not the court's number and not the police department's

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the shared semantics refuse a government identifier on any form
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your Social Security number, as the form asks
